title: Asahina Mafuyu — Encounter At A Closed School〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, K. I'll keep drawing with that in mind.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, I have a good idea of what the lyrics will be like. Do you have time to talk later?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, everyone! I just finished going through the pictures I took during our little trip! I've sent you all a link to a folder with them in it♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I knew it felt too quiet.
That's what you were up to?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I've gotten a lot done already. Maybe I'll take a quick peek.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Go for it!
You too, K, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Some memories might come rushing back and turn into an awesome melody or cool lyrics, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wonder if there's one of that cherry blossom tree...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, this one's from inside the train! You got some good landscapes. It sort of feels like we went on a real vacation when you look at it like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm a natural photographer, right? Alright, get ready for some more blasts from the past♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? What are you talking about? If you take out the train we took, you're left with photos of all the haunted stuff we saw!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, duh... What if there's something that really shouldn't be there in one of these...? That'd be pretty spooky, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Wait, you didn't actually see anything... Right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heh heh heh. You'll just have find out for yourselves♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then I might just stop and get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Aww, come on! We had so much fun together, so you gotta look!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This folder looks like the one for that shrine we went to...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Which means this is the one for the abandoned school...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This is it, but they're all pictures of the school's windows...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia, why did you take so many pictures of the school's windows?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, that? I was hoping that I'd get lucky and capture a ghost or something, you know♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Bummer, right? It totally felt like that sort of place too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Instead of the school itself, taking pictures of its surrounding may've been better.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Then you might've seen the girl that tugged on my skirt.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<The girl with the red backpack.
She kept appearing and disappearing, so she might've been a ghost.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't actually know, but she tugged on my skirt and I decided to follow her.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She led me to this tree with an old shoe tied to it by its laces...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think someone did something mean to her and she wanted me to get her shoe back...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <After I returned it to her, she disappeared.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Are you sure it wasn't just one of the local kids using the school as their playground?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Maybe, but the shoe on that tree looked incredibly old...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think she called to me again, so I followed her...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Because I saw some cherry blossom petals dancing in the wind...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, that's how you ended up under that tree.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia, do you have any pictures of that tree...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? Yeah, of course. Keep scrolling in the abandoned school folder and you should see some.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<A-Are you sure about this?
If that ghost Yuki saw is there...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's beautiful, but looks like an ordinary cherry blossom tree...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. I felt the exact same way!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There's something special about seeing it in real life as opposed to in a photo.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I should get back to work.
Thank you for taking these.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wouldn't mind going on another trip like this...)
